full_judgment: 11. As stated hereinbefore, on 21-5-91 opposite party Nos.1 to 4 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 62 of 1991 for a decree of declaration of title in the suit land. On 29-9-93 defendant No.1 filed a written statement. In paragraph 9 of the written statement, the case of the plaintiffs regarding 'pattan' and payment of rents was denied. Then, the plaintiffs on 8-2-99 produced in Court six 'farog' ie rent receipts and made an application for an order directing defendant No.1 for production of the counterfoils of said rent receipts. By an order dated 3-5-99 the application was allowed and the defendant was so directed to produce the counterfoils.
